manifesto.statement: We draw the design ourselves, build it in our own workshop, and install it with our own hands. Every piece is made precisely for your space.
manifesto.noteOne: We have no standard sizes — we start from your walls, ceilings, and habits. The furniture adapts to the space, never the other way around.
manifesto.noteTwo: Apartments and houses, offices, cafés, and shops — one team from design to handover.

pricing.a: We quote after a free measurement and an agreed design. The price is fixed in writing and never changes.

timeline.a: Production takes 3–5 weeks on average after design approval. Installation usually takes 1–3 days.

materials.q: What materials do you use, and is there a warranty?
materials.a: We work with European MDF and solid wood; hardware is Blum and Häfele. Every piece we build is covered by a warranty.

commercial.a: Yes — offices, cafés, and shops, from single pieces to complete turnkey fit-outs.

audio.label: Listen
audio.transcript: Welcome to Kencho Group. We're a small team in Tbilisi that designs, builds, and installs custom furniture — all under one roof. Every project begins in your space: we visit, we measure, and we listen to how you live. Our designers then draw your interior in 3D, so you see the result before we cut a single board. In our own workshop, your kitchen, wardrobe, or complete interior takes shape within three to five weeks — European materials, precise joinery, and a warranty on everything we make. Then we arrive, install cleanly, and hand over a finished space. If you're thinking about a project of your own, write to us on WhatsApp. The measurement is free.
